name: Family Reunification Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being a close family member of an alien holding a Georgian residence permit, with proof of the family relationship (kinship).
Requires monthly income equal to at least 2 times Georgia's official minimum subsistence level.
requirements.fix_path: Document qualifying monthly income before applying.

evidence_required.document: Proof of the sponsor's own valid residence permit
Proof of funds (2x minimum subsistence level)

outcome.duration_length: 6 months to 1 year initially, extendable up to a cumulative 12 years

sources.title: Public Service Development Agency of Georgia (sda.gov.ge) -- Migration/Residence Permits

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Georgia's initial build. This is Article 15(c). This route is for family members of an alien residence-permit holder generally -- distinct from ge_permanent_residence's own spouse-of-Georgian-CITIZEN group, which is a different, stronger status reached directly (Article 15(g)), not via this permit. work_rights set 'none': not described as permitted in the source; not asserted absent confirmation. HONEST GAP: exact qualifying degrees of kinship beyond 'family member' were not itemised in the source fetched (unlike some other countries' spouse/minor-child/parent breakdowns in this dataset) -- a single, undifferentiated family_tie requirement is used rather than inventing a list.
